test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in reported (or indirect) speech.

The postmaster said to her, “You can purchase only two stamps at a time.”

options.text: The postmaster told her that she can purchase only two stamps at a time.
The postmaster asked her that she could purchase only two stamps at a time.
The postmaster instructed her that she should purchase only two stamps at a time.
The postmaster told her that she could purchase only two stamps at a time.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the steps for changing the sentence from **direct **to **indirect speech:**
 
• In the given sentence the reporting verb has **an object**. Hence, **'said to'** will be changed into **'told'. **
 
• **Comma (,) **and** inverted commas("...")** will be removed. 
 
• The conjunction '**that**' will be added.
 
• '**You**' will be changed into '**she**' according to the subject of the reporting statement.
 
• Here, "**can**" turns into "**could**" because when the sentence is reported later, the action has already happened or the words have already been spoken.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***"The postmaster told her that she could purchase only two stamps at a time."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
